title: Podcast EP379: How yieldWerx is Creating a Path to the Future with Aftkhar Aslam
gist: A thin SemiWiki podcast listing (Semiconductor Insiders EP379, 19:18) in which Daniel Nenni interviews yieldWerx co-founder and CEO/CTO Aftkhar Aslam about yield-data analytics for advanced packaging, silicon photonics and emerging quantum technologies, and the new yieldWerx IQ system; the page itself contains only the episode summary, not the discussion.

insights.claim: Semiconductor yield-analytics firm yieldWerx is positioning its data-analytics platform to support advanced packaging, silicon photonics and emerging quantum technologies.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Points to growing yield-data complexity in heterogeneous packaging and photonics as a niche opportunity for yield-management software vendors.
insights.locator: Daniel explores how yieldWerx has evolved

insights.claim: yieldWerx has launched a new AI-related product, the yieldWerx IQ system, discussed in Semiconductor Insiders podcast EP379.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Yield-analytics vendors are adding AI layers; a small private player to watch in semiconductor manufacturing data intelligence.
insights.locator: Daniel also explores the impact of AI

insights.claim: yieldWerx co-founder and CEO/CTO Aftkhar Aslam has over 30 years in semiconductor manufacturing and yield engineering, previously held senior roles at Texas Instruments, and has led yield optimization for Intel, Qualcomm and Microsoft.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Founder pedigree with tier-one chipmakers lends credibility to yieldWerx's enterprise yield-analytics pitch.
insights.locator: Daniel is joined by Aftkhar Aslam
